meta.query: Which drugs frequently co-occur in combination studies for pancreatic cancer?

interpretation.rationale: A drug–drug co-occurrence network (drug vs drug) will identify which drugs are most often tested together in trials for pancreatic cancer.

plan.rationale: A drug–drug co-occurrence network (drug vs drug) will identify which drugs are most often tested together in trials for pancreatic cancer.

ambiguities: The user asked for "frequently" but did not specify a time window or a threshold for frequency (e.g., top N or minimum co-occurrence count).

Unclear whether the user wants to include only interventional combination trials or also observational/expanded-access studies; I left study_type and intervention_types unspecified to include all trials that list drugs for pancreatic cancer.

meta.counting_rule: Node trial_count = distinct trials listing the entity; edge weight = distinct trials in which both entities appear. Each trial is counted once even if it lists an entity several times.
meta.sort: nodes by trial_count descending; edges by weight descending
warnings: cohort 'Pancreatic cancer': analyzed 5000 of 5106 matching trials (raise max_studies up to 10000 for full coverage)
notes: showing top 12 of 1486 connected drug nodes (by trial count)
